meera: Hey team — drafting a manager + HR onboarding framework tailored for early engineering hires. Need a compact Day 0/1 checklist, Week 1 outcomes, and a suggested 30/60/90 metric-driven template. Paste and adapt for your hires.

dylan: Thanks, will use this and set measurable goals in Week-1 1:1. I'll also pick a mentor and starter ticket that touches CI.

meera: Framework (copy for managers):

PRE-START (48-72h)
- IT: laptop ordered or loaner reserved; VPN + SSO request filed.
- People Ops: Slack + calendar invites (intro, manager 1:1 weekly, team sync).
- DevEx: repo access request + onboarding README link.
- Manager: starter task + acceptance criteria, buddy assigned.

DAY 1 (first business day)
- 09:00 welcome (People Ops) — paperwork + benefits quick brief.
- 10:00 env setup (DevEx/IT) — pair to run repo, smoke tests.
- 11:00 team intros (round robin, 10m each).
- Lunch with buddy (informal).
- 14:00 starter task assigned (small PR to run CI).
- 16:30 EOD manager sync (clarify expectations + 30/60/90 draft).

WEEK 1 OBJECTIVES
- Run local stack and pass smoke tests.
- Merge or close starter PR.
- Meet PM, SRE, Security for context (15-30m each).
- Have draft 30/60/90 with measurable criteria.

30/60/90 SUGGESTED TEMPLATE (edit per role)
- 30d: complete dev env, ship first small change (1-2 PRs merged), participate in 1 on-call walkthrough or CI review.
- 60d: take ownership of a backlog stream or small feature, improve a measurable metric (test coverage, latency, flake rate) by X%.
- 90d: lead a small rollout or cross-team demo, document decisions and next quarter proposals.

ROLES & OWNERS
- People Ops: paperwork, calendar invites, benefits intro.
- IT: hardware + account provisioning.
- DevEx: onboarding README, devcontainer fallback.
- Manager: starter task, mentor pairing, measurable 30/60/90 goals.
- Security: dataset access approvals + NDA handling.

meera: Quick operational notes: include acceptance criteria for each 30/60/90 item (e.g., "merge 2 PRs with green CI", "reduce test flakiness by 20%"), and set checkpoints in manager 1:1 at 2 weeks and 6 weeks.

dylan: Assigning mentor @mentor-liz. @it-bot please confirm provisioning by EOD Fri.

it-bot: IT ticket #15234 created for arya.k — standard laptop + VPN + SSO. ETA: 48 hours.

arya.k: Quick q — who authorizes access to customer sandbox for my starter task?

san: @arya.k Security requires manager approval + brief justification. Use https://internal.redwood.dev/sec/request-access and attach the NDA if customer data is involved. I'll start the access ticket when manager signs off.

devex: Linking onboarding repo and README: git.internal/redwood/onboarding-engineering and https://internal.redwood.dev/devex/onboard-guide. If laptop delayed I'll spin up a cloud devcontainer so Arya can start coding.

mentor-liz: Mentor checklist (short): meet Day 1, be available 45m/day Week 1, review starter PRs within 24h, intro to team rituals. I'll DM a checklist template to @dylan.

arya.k: Thanks everyone! One more: is there a preferred 30/60/90 doc structure so I can draft my plan before Day 1?

meera: Yes — use /hr/templates/30-60-90-engineering.md. Keep metrics specific and include acceptance checkboxes. I'll attach it to the calendar invite.

dylan: Great — I'll finalize the measurable goals in the Day 1 sync and share the doc with Arya.

meera: Closing loop — I'll update the central onboarding template with these role owners and follow up when IT marks the ticket done. :white_check_mark:

arya.k: Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to start! :wave:
